subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should the bundled Slack plugin expose both `channel-info` and `channel-list` as supported agent actions, and if so, what single capability gate and scope policy should govern them?
rationale: Current main has no public Slack channel-discovery action group, while the only linked open implementation adds only one requested action and an unrelated search surface; source inspection cannot choose the permanent product and authorization contract.

options.title: Adopt focused two-action parity
options.body: Add only `channel-info` and paginated `channel-list` to the Slack plugin under one documented least-privilege gate, with token-scope, allowlist, docs, and contract coverage.

options.title: Accept discovery-only scope
options.body: Sponsor `channel-list` alone as a separately documented Slack capability and open or retain a narrow follow-up for `channel-info` rather than claiming this issue is fixed.

options.title: Keep discovery external
options.body: Decline a bundled Slack expansion and direct the capability to an external plugin if maintainers do not want another built-in agent action surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt focused two-action parity
recommendation.body: Add only `channel-info` and paginated `channel-list` to the Slack plugin under one documented least-privilege gate, with token-scope, allowlist, docs, and contract coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Slack message-action boundary and adjacent documentation history most strongly connect this decision to steipete.
